# Two rounds in one project, with the default base_reds_file, write two records. The later round does not replace the record of the earlier one,
# and each record holds the reds of its own round.
isolate

exec git init -q -b main origin
exec git -C origin add readme.txt
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m start
exec git -C origin checkout -q -b integration/r1
exec git -C origin add BASE_MARKER
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base-one
exec git -C origin checkout -q -b integration/r2
exec git -C origin add SECOND_MARKER
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base-two
exec git -C origin checkout -q main

fixture project.star config/projects/local.star
replace config/projects/local.star '~/work/your-repo' $WORK/origin
replace config/projects/local.star 'test_report = "reports/*.xml",' 'test_report = "reports/*.xml", vars = {"round": {"base": "integration/r1", "owner": "owner", "lane_cap": 1, "fix_rounds": 1, "label": "round", "base_reds": ["RedOfRoundOne"]}},'
example remediation/workflow.star flow/example.star
replace flow/example.star 'def main(item):' 'def round_main(item):'
exec cat flow/example.star flow/driver.star
cp stdout flow/round.star

exec beehestreal item add local round/integration/r1 --title 'The first round' --body-file body.txt
exec beehestreal run round/integration/r1 local --workflow flow/round.star
stdout 'item round/integration/r1 finished'

replace config/projects/local.star '"base": "integration/r1"' '"base": "integration/r2"'
replace config/projects/local.star 'RedOfRoundOne' 'RedOfRoundTwo'
exec beehestreal item add local round/integration/r2 --title 'The second round' --body-file body.txt
exec beehestreal run round/integration/r2 local --workflow flow/round.star
stdout 'item round/integration/r2 finished'

# Each round has its own record, outside every round folder.
grep 'RedOfRoundOne' state/trees/local/base-reds-integration_2Fr1.md
! grep 'RedOfRoundTwo' state/trees/local/base-reds-integration_2Fr1.md
grep 'RedOfRoundTwo' state/trees/local/base-reds-integration_2Fr2.md
! grep 'RedOfRoundOne' state/trees/local/base-reds-integration_2Fr2.md

-- body.txt --
The round of the base.
-- origin/readme.txt --
The source repository.
-- origin/BASE_MARKER --
base marker
-- origin/SECOND_MARKER --
second marker
-- flow/driver.star --

def main(item):
    record_base_reds(settings(facts()))
